name: swe-corpus-explorer
description: Single-viewport explorer of a unified embedded-software research corpus (421 resources, six passes, five relational models). Raw HTML/CSS/JS, no framework, no build step at view time.

comments.toolchain: Versions pinned to the mid-2026 baseline (web_platform_baseline_manifest §7). These run in CI, not the browser — the shipped app has zero runtime dependencies. Node was unavailable in the authoring environment, so `check`/`test` are the committed contract, not a verified run (see README).
